g.text: Moving or deleting a release tag or branch

text.tspan: cd.yml runs on main: the newest
run again after a stop half-way: it finds
release/YYYY.N with no version and finishes it
seven files = YYYY.N.P; only the version
beside main, staging ran its commit; canary present
job built: CD run of the head
canary, smoke test, Harbor tag YYYY.N.P,
helm upgrade by version, canary removed
publish: generate-notes since the release below;
main merged in); gh pr create into main;
gh workflow run ci.yml on it

g.text: merge the pull request into main

text.tspan: released or used up): version pull
the same checks, canary, prod, tag,
pull request back (main keeps a higher version)
